note: 与其他 Emissary 共享台词模板,详见 Emissary_Braum.json 的说明和 GLOSSARY.md。

messages.context: 无进行中委托时的开场白,要马铃薯办国王的宴会
messages.text: The King's favorite emissary is here to request potatoes for the King's great feast!
messages.zh: 国王最喜欢的委托官来啦,为国王的盛大宴会征集马铃薯!
messages.raw: §fThe King's favorite emissary is here to request potatoes for the King's great feast!

messages.text: Maybe the King will even announce me as his favorite at the feast!
messages.zh: 说不定国王会在宴会上当众宣布我是他最喜欢的那个!
messages.raw: §fMaybe the King will even announce me as his favorite at the feast!

messages.context: 拒绝/取消委托时的台词
messages.text: I will inform the King about this disgrace!
messages.zh: 我会把这次耻辱禀报给国王的!
messages.raw: §fI will inform the King about this disgrace!
